description: This file contains functions and types for retrieving and processing booking data, including handling old booking formats, rescheduling logic, and attendee masking for seated events.

methods.name: getResponsesFromOldBooking
methods.description: Converts legacy booking data into a standardized response format.

methods.name: getBooking
methods.description: Fetches a booking by UID, including related data, and formats date fields.

methods.name: getBookingWithResponses
methods.description: Augments booking data with responses, handling old format fallback.

methods.name: getBookingForReschedule
methods.description: Retrieves booking data for rescheduling, including ownership and permission checks.

methods.name: getBookingForSeatedEvent
methods.description: Fetches a booking with attendee emails masked for seated events.

methods.name: getMultipleDurationValue
methods.description: Returns a duration value based on configuration and query input.
